mods.name: OrbusRebornCamera
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Desktop creator camera for OrbusVR Reborn with an F2 control panel, POV, third-person, selfie and static recording modes, adjustable FOV, smoothness and distance, and optional local avatar visibility.

mods.name: OrbusQuestHelper
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental client-side OrbusVR quest helper. Early builds inspect mission and journal UI; planned features include region-grouped missions, quest tracking, event alerts and fishing guidance.

mods.name: CastMetrics
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental Runemage casts-per-second wand HUD for Community and Spades. Community cast event probe; Spades casting and DPS require validation. Configurable text scale and position.

mods.name: OrbusGoblinTimer
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental Trickster Goblin countdown for Community and Spades. Uses observed spawn announcements or a manual sync; never tracks the goblin's location.

mods.name: RebornMenu
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental in-game VR parchment mod menu prototype. Wrist rune and controller pointer are being tested; generic configuration editing is still in development. Optional BepInEx client plugin.

mods.name: OrbusAbilityLabels
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Small floating labels above Bard and Musketeer abilities. Eight mapped Bard mesh abbreviations (GH, CW, IJ, HA, PR, IN, SP, DF) and compact text. Optional Bard mesh debug panel, off by default.

mods.name: OrbusPaladinRangeFix
mods.author: Hor1zonVR
mods.description: Experimental read-only Paladin hammer teleport and mount/combat diagnostics. Captures local rig and nearby mechanic objects with F8/F9/F10/F11; does not yet change teleport or summoning.
